=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
note code of each letter a..z: 0 vowel (and y), 1..6 consonant groups, 7 h and w (ignored)
text codes "01230127022455012623017202"
text n0 "Robert"
text n1 "Rupert"
text n2 "Rubin"
text n3 "Ashcraft"
text n4 "Ashcroft"
text n5 "Tymczak"
text n6 "Pfister"
text n7 "Honeyman"
text n8 "Lee"
text n9 "Gutierrez"
text n10 "Jackson"
text n11 "VanDeusen"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note American Soundex: keep the first letter, code the rest, drop repeats of the same code (h and w
note do not separate them, vowels do), pad with zeros to four characters
fn soundex a view uchar * to void
o = new uchar 4 48
c = get a 0
if ge c 97
c = sub c 32
end
put o 0 c
prev = get codes sub c 65
k = ulong 1
for i ulong sub len a 1
x = get a add i 1
if ge x 97
x = sub x 32
end
d = get codes sub x 65
if eq d 48
prev = d
else
if and ne d 55 ne d prev
if lt k 4
put o k d
k = add k 1
end
prev = d
end
end
end
emit a
emit sp
emit o
emit nl
end
fn main to int
soundex n0
soundex n1
soundex n2
soundex n3
soundex n4
soundex n5
soundex n6
soundex n7
soundex n8
soundex n9
soundex n10
soundex n11
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
Robert R163
Rupert R163
Rubin R150
Ashcraft A261
Ashcroft A261
Tymczak T522
Pfister P236
Honeyman H555
Lee L000
Gutierrez G362
Jackson J250
VanDeusen V532
</pre>
